extraSnippets: # [My Annoying Opinions](https://myannoyingopinions.com/ "My Annoying Opinions") ## food, whisky and more… [![](https://i0.wp.com/myannoyingopinions.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/compass-box-spice-tree-extravaganza.jpg?resize=195%2C300&ssl=1)](https://myannoyingopinions.com/2024/01/24/compass-box-spice-tree-extravaganza/compass-box-spice-tree-extravaganza-2/#main) Compass Box week continues. On Monday I had a review of their [Stranger & Stranger](https://myannoyingopinions.com/2024/01/22/compass-box-stranger-stranger/), which I thought was decent but nothing more (and not at all a good value for the high price charged for it). Today I have a review for you of their Spice Tree Extravaganza. This was a limited edition take on their regular Spice Tree release, which had a slightly checkered history, having run into problems with whisky regulations and going off the market for a few years before coming back. Despite it having come back, however, Compass Box saw fit to mark the 10th anniversary of its original discontinuation with this release in 2016. It’s put together in a complicated manner.
